title: Envelope Team Definition
description: Schema for an Envelope AI team definition. Reference as $schema in your .envelope.json file.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the registry.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique within the registry. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

version.description: Semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Versions are immutable once published.

description.description: Short description shown in the registry.

category.description: Registry category. Teams submitted without a valid category are published under 'other'.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search. Not yet indexed for filtering — planned for registry v2.

visibility.description: 'public' — listed in registry. 'team' — org members only. 'private' — publishing API key only.

forkable.description: Whether other builders may fork this team. Defaults to true for public teams.

readme.description: Long-form Markdown documentation shown on the team's registry page.

icon.description: URL of a square PNG or SVG icon (min 256x256px). Must be publicly accessible.

inputs.description: Named input fields the team accepts. Accepted by the registry; schema enforcement planned for v2.

outputs.description: Named output fields the team returns. Accepted by the registry; output validation planned for v2.

requiredSecrets.description: Secret names the deployer must supply at install time. Values are never in the schema.

requiredVariables.description: Non-secret variable names the deployer must supply at install time.

changelog.description: Human-readable description of what changed in this version. Best practice: include on every publish.

gates.description: Human review checkpoints between pipeline steps.

pipeline.description: Ordered sequence of pipeline steps. When present, the runtime executes steps in order rather than dispatching all agents concurrently.

Pricing.description: Omit entirely for free teams. When present, model is required.

model.description: 'subscription' is planned — not yet available in v1.

amount.description: Price in the specified currency. Required when model is 'per_run' or 'per_k_tokens'.

interval.description: Required when model is 'subscription'. Defaults to 'month'.

trialDays.description: Free trial length in days. Only applicable when model is 'subscription'.

ForkedFrom.description: Attribution when this team was derived from another.

TeamTimeout.description: Default timeout configuration for all agents in the team. Per-agent modelConfig.timeoutMs overrides this.

runMs.description: Maximum wall-clock time in ms for the entire run.

agentMs.description: Maximum time in ms for a single agent invocation.

IOField.description: An input or output field definition.

enum.description: Restricts value to one of these options.

default.description: Default value when the field is not supplied.

key.description: Unique within the team. Used in reportsToKey references.

title.description: Job title shown in the team diagram. E.g. 'Head of Support'.

role.description: Free-form role description. Suggested values: 'manager', 'specialist', 'analyst'. Custom values are valid and passed through unchanged.

adapterType.description: Runtime adapter. Runtimes must support 'http'. Local adapters are optional.

reportsToKey.description: Key of the parent agent. Omit for top-level (root) agents.

prompt.description: System prompt. May reference secrets as {{SECRET_NAME}} and variables as {{VARIABLE_NAME}}.

model.description: LLM in 'provider:model' format. E.g. 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-5'. Use this unless you need temperature or maxTokens.

allowedHosts.description: Simple hostname allowlist. Cannot be combined with accessPolicy.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data preserved by the registry. Not interpreted by the runtime.

ModelConfig.description: Full LLM configuration. Alternative to the flat 'model' field — use one or the other.

timeoutMs.description: Per-agent timeout in ms. Overrides team.timeout.agentMs.

AccessPolicy.description: Structured outbound request rules. Use in place of allowedHosts for deny rules, path matching, or reason strings.

defaultAction.description: Applied when no rule matches. 'deny' is strongly recommended for agents with a known set of integrations.

AccessPolicyRule.description: A single access policy rule. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins.

host.description: Hostname to match. Supports leading wildcard (*.domain.com). Omit to match all hosts.

methods.description: HTTP methods to match. Omit to match all methods.

pathPrefix.description: URL path prefix to match. Omit to match all paths.

action.description: 'require_approval' is treated as 'deny' in v1 — reserved for v2. Definitions using it today are forward-compatible.

reason.description: Shown in block messages and activity logs. Strongly recommended on 'deny' rules.

HumanGate.description: A human review checkpoint between pipeline steps.

name.description: Unique name within the pipeline. Used as a stable identifier in webhook payloads and audit logs.

type.description: The nature of the human decision.

afterStep.description: Key of the pipeline step whose output produces the records waiting for review.

triggersStep.description: Key of the pipeline step that runs once the gate trigger condition is met.

fields.description: Record field names to surface in the review UI.

trigger.description: When to release the gate and run the next step.

thresholdCount.description: Required when trigger is 'threshold'. Number of approved records needed.

onReject.description: What happens when a human rejects a record.

recordActions.description: Per-record actions available in the review table.

label.description: Button label shown in the review UI.

endpointTemplate.description: API endpoint to call. Use {fieldName} interpolation for record identifiers. {installId} is injected automatically.

behaviour.description: 'escalate' — route to coordinator. 'halt' — stop and notify. 'proceed' — release and continue.

PipelineStep.description: A single step in an ordered pipeline.

key.description: Unique step identifier within the pipeline.

agentKey.description: Key of the agent that executes this step.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the operator dashboard.

dependsOn.description: Keys of steps that must complete before this step runs.
